description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'ExecutionContextAuthHandler' that implements authentication handling for devices within a specific execution context. It provides mechanisms to authenticate devices using an 'AuthProvider' and manages context-specific authentication details.

classes.name: ExecutionContextAuthHandler
classes.description: An abstract class for handling device authentication within a specific execution context, utilizing an 'AuthProvider' and supporting context-specific credential parsing.

methods.name: getAuthProvider
